$schema.description: Optional path or URL of the JSON Schema, for editors (ignored by `wtl`).

extends.description: A run file this one builds on, relative to this file (e.g. `./base.json`). Its keys are the defaults: objects (`mount`, `vars`) merge key by key, anything else (`steps` included) is replaced. Paths in it are relative to that file.

vars.description: Variables for `${WTL_NAME}` in this file's string values, and set in every step's environment in the guest. Each name is `WTL_` + `A-Z 0-9 _`; the value is the default (a host environment variable of the same name wins), `null` for one that must be set, or `{ "default": ..., "secret": true }` for one that is never written to the results.

lab.description: The lab to boot: a name (`labs/<lab>.json` in win-test-lab, e.g. `school`) or a path to a lab file, relative to this run file (e.g. `./lab.json`). A value with a `/` or `\` or ending in `.json` is a path. Required, here or in the file this one extends.

name.description: Label for the results folder (default: the run file's stem).

wait.description: Seconds a step may run before it counts as "still running" (default 60).

timeout_min.description: Give up on the whole run after this many minutes (default 60).

mount.description: Host folder for each drive letter, e.g. `{ "X": "./app" }` (read-only in the guest).

VarDef.description: One run variable: its default value, or the long form with `secret`.

VarSpec.description: The long form of a run variable.

default.description: The default value; absent or `null`: the variable must be set in the environment.

secret.description: If true, the value is shown as `***` in `result.json` and in `wtl`'s output (the guest still gets the real value).

on.description: Where to run: a machine name, a list of names, or `all` (every member, not the DC). Default `all`.

as.description: Who to run as: `system` (full rights) or a user name. Default: the user logged on to that machine (its `logon` user, else Administrator). A step on the DC needs an `as`.

expect_exit.description: Exit code that counts as success (default 0).

wait.description: Seconds this step may run before it counts as "still running" (default: the run's `wait`).

keep_running.description: If true, a program still running at `wait` counts as OK and is left running.

OnSpec.description: a machine name, a list of machine names, or "all" (every member)
